page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Arabic and Hebrew transcribed from the scan; the Arabic line ending "ويخاطبه" and the Hebrew of the Eleazar quotation are doubtful and were not fully verified. The Greek word after "ad alterius" is only partly legible. The Arabic line before "Innuit hoc dicto" and the phrase "الآخر وتتم" are partly legible and may be misordered. The italic/roman distinction in some Latin words (e.g., "Maimonides", "in Comment:") is approximate. The printed text starts mid-sentence and continues onto the next page.
